rationale: The sample describes cloud control-plane operations with operation names, action categories, results, actors, source IP addresses, targets, before and after values, and correlation identifiers. Role assignment and service principal credential operations also provide a defensible UserManagement secondary schema, but AuditEvent is primary because every record is an administrative or audit operation.

evidence.details: All 30 JSONL records include EventType, OperationName, OperationCategory, OperationResult, actor identity and IP fields, target resource fields, and request or correlation identifiers.
The supplied descriptions define control-plane operations, operation outcomes, audit settings, policy values, role assignments, credentials, exports, and resource targets.

The request identifies successful privileged role assignment after failed attempts, audit tampering, API key creation, service principal credential creation, external sharing, public API exposure, export completion, and backup deletion.
